Ladakh L-G Saxena Approves Sports Policy with Cash Perks and Scholarships

The Ladakh Lieutenant Governor (L-G) Saxena has approved a new sports policy offering monthly scholarships to students and one-time cash incentives to athletes. The policy aims to promote sports in Ladakh and provide financial support to young athletes. The L-G has also announced plans to establish a sports academy in the region. The policy is expected to benefit over 1,000 students and athletes in Ladakh. The government said it would provide Rs 10 crore for the establishment of the sports academy.
